## Data

### viz area

Line chart with a soft filled area underneath.
- aliases: area-chart, filled-line  |  entry kinds: item, point  |  sweet spot: 2–14 items
- option `yTitle:` (string) — y-axis title
- option `xTitle:` (string) — x-axis title
- option `color:` (string) — line color override
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz area "Storage Used" {
  yTitle: "TB"
  item "2021" 14
  item "2022" 22
  item "2023" 31
  item "2024" 52
  item "2025" 78
}
```

### viz bar

Column chart with per-category colors and value labels.
- aliases: column, bar-chart, bars, vertical-bar  |  entry kinds: item, bar  |  sweet spot: 1–12 items
- option `yTitle:` (string) — y-axis title
- option `xTitle:` (string) — x-axis title
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz bar "Revenue by Quarter" {
  yTitle: "Revenue ($k)"
  item "Q1" 120
  item "Q2" 180
  item "Q3" 150
  item "Q4" 240
}
```

### viz bar-horizontal

Horizontal bars with circular category badges.
- aliases: hbar, horizontal-bar, bar-chart-horizontal  |  entry kinds: item, bar  |  sweet spot: 1–8 items
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz bar-horizontal "Team Capacity" {
  item "Engineering" 34 { icon: gear }
  item "Design" 12 { icon: heart }
  item "Marketing" 18 { icon: megaphone }
  item "Support" 22 { icon: chat }
}
```

### viz bullet-chart

KPI rows — actual bar vs a target tick over a qualitative band.
- aliases: bullet, kpi-vs-target, target-bars  |  entry kinds: item, kpi  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `max:` (number) — one scale ceiling for every row (default: each row scales to its own max(actual, target) × 1.15; a row's own `max:` wins over both)
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print actual values (default true)

```edd
viz bullet-chart "Q3 Scorecard" {
  kpi "Revenue" 74 90
  kpi "NPS" 61 55
  kpi "Uptime" 99.5 99.9
  kpi "Hiring" 6 10
}
```

### viz drop-off

Nested rounded cards stepping down-right, each sized by its value, called out in a column beside them.
- aliases: dropoff, attrition, funnel-drop, leakage  |  entry kinds: item, stage  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz drop-off "Signup Funnel Loss" {
  item "Visit" 100 { icon: eye }
  item "Sign up" 42 { icon: user }
  item "Activate" 18 { icon: check }
}
```

### viz dumbbell-horizontal

Rows of tracks with value bars and a hanging tag bubble.
- aliases: progress-bars, tracks, goal-progress, kpi-bars  |  entry kinds: item, row  |  sweet spot: 2–8 items
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz dumbbell-horizontal "Goal Progress" {
  item "Docs coverage" 80 "80%"
  item "Test coverage" 65 "65%"
  item "Accessibility" 90 "90%"
  item "Performance" 72 "72%"
}
```

### viz dumbbell-vertical

Alternating capsules with a delta badge, connected to text blocks.
- aliases: deltas, change-comparison, yoy, before-after-values  |  entry kinds: item, row  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz dumbbell-vertical "Year over Year" {
  item "Speed Score" "+15%" { icon: rocket, detail: "Increased from 70 to 85." }
  item "Retention" "+8%" { icon: heart, detail: "Now at 92% after onboarding fixes." }
  item "Cost per Lead" "−22%" { icon: dollar, detail: "Down from $18 to $14." }
}
```

### viz gauge

A 270° dial showing one value (0–100).
- aliases: dial, meter, speedometer  |  entry kinds: item, value  |  sweet spot: 1–1 items
- option `value:` (number) — dial value 0–100 (else the first item's value)
- option `label:` (string) — caption below the dial (else the first item's label)
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz gauge "System Health" {
  value: 87
  label: "Uptime score"
}
```

### viz heatmap

A matrix of intensity-shaded cells — risk matrices, skills grids.
- aliases: heat-map, intensity-grid, risk-matrix, skills-grid  |  entry kinds: row, item  |  sweet spot: 2–7 items
- option `cols:` (string[]) — column headers, e.g. ["Q1","Q2","Q3"]
- option `max:` (number) — intensity ceiling (default: largest value)
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print cell values (default true)

```edd
viz heatmap "Incidents per Service" {
  cols: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]
  row "API" [3, 5, 2, 1]
  row "Web" [1, 2, 1, 0]
  row "Billing" [4, 6, 5, 2]
  row "Auth" [0, 1, 3, 1]
}
```

### viz line

Line chart with point markers and value labels.
- aliases: line-chart, line-graph  |  entry kinds: item, point  |  sweet spot: 2–14 items
- option `yTitle:` (string) — y-axis title
- option `xTitle:` (string) — x-axis title
- option `color:` (string) — line color override
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz line "Active Users" {
  yTitle: "Users"
  xTitle: "Month"
  item "Jan" 1200
  item "Feb" 1350
  item "Mar" 1600
  item "Apr" 1580
  item "May" 1900
  item "Jun" 2400
}
```

### viz pie

Pie/donut chart with percentage callouts.
- aliases: donut, pie-chart, doughnut, share  |  entry kinds: item, slice  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `variant:` (pie|donut) — "donut" cuts a hole in the middle
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz pie "Market Share" {
  item "Alpha" 45
  item "Beta" 30
  item "Gamma" 15
  item "Others" 10
}
```

### viz radar

Spider chart — 1-3 series polygons over 4-8 labeled axes.
- aliases: spider, spider-chart, radar-chart, capability-map, skills-chart  |  entry kinds: axis, series, item  |  sweet spot: 4–8 items
- option `max:` (number) — scale maximum (default: largest value)

```edd
viz radar "Platform Assessment" {
  axis "Security"
  axis "Performance"
  axis "Docs"
  axis "Ecosystem"
  axis "DX"
  series "Today" [3, 4, 2, 3, 2]
  series "Target" [5, 4, 4, 4, 5]
}
```

### viz sankey

Sources → targets with value-thick ribbons (`flow a -> b 25`).
- aliases: flow-diagram, sankey-diagram, flows  |  entry kinds: flow, item, node, source, target  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz sankey "Energy Mix" {
  flow "Coal" -> "Industry" 25
  flow "Coal" -> "Homes" 10
  flow "Solar" -> "Homes" 30
  flow "Solar" -> "Industry" 12
  flow "Wind" -> "Industry" 18
  flow "Wind" -> "Homes" 15
}
```

### viz slope-chart

Before → after lines, one per series — rank and magnitude change at a glance.
- aliases: slope, slopegraph, before-after-lines, rank-change  |  entry kinds: item, series  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `left:` (string) — left column header (default "Before")
- option `right:` (string) — right column header (default "After")
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print endpoint values (default true)

```edd
viz slope-chart "Ticket Volume" {
  left: "2026"
  right: "2027"
  item "Billing" 340 120
  item "Onboarding" 210 190
  item "API" 90 160
  item "Other" 150 60
}
```

### viz stacked-bar

Stacked columns; rows are `item "Q1" [a, b, c]`, legend via `series`.
- aliases: stacked-column, stacked-bars  |  entry kinds: item, row, series  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `yTitle:` (string) — y-axis title
- option `xTitle:` (string) — x-axis title
- option `legend:` (string) — list of series names for the legend
- option `series:` (string) — alias for legend
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print segment values and stack totals (default true)

```edd
viz stacked-bar "Budget by Quarter" {
  series "People"
  series "Tools"
  series "Marketing"
  item "Q1" [80, 20, 30]
  item "Q2" [90, 25, 45]
  item "Q3" [95, 22, 38]
}
```

### viz stacked-bar-horizontal

Horizontal stacked bars with a value axis and legend.
- aliases: stacked-hbar, horizontal-stacked-bar  |  entry kinds: item, row, series  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `legend:` (string) — list of series names for the legend
- option `series:` (string) — alias for legend
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz stacked-bar-horizontal "Department Budgets" {
  series "Salaries"
  series "Equipment"
  series "Travel"
  item "Engineering" [120000, 30000, 12000]
  item "Sales" [90000, 15000, 40000]
  item "Operations" [70000, 25000, 8000]
}
```

### viz waterfall

Start bar, floating signed deltas (green up, red down), computed net bar, level connectors.
- aliases: waterfall-chart, cascade, bridge-chart  |  entry kinds: item, delta, total, net, end  |  sweet spot: 2–8 items
- option `yTitle:` (string) — y-axis title
- option `xTitle:` (string) — x-axis title
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz waterfall "Cash Flow" {
  item "Opening" 500
  item "Rent" -200
  item "Payroll" -120
  item "Marketing" -40
  total "Closing"
}
```

## Hierarchy

### viz bullseye

Concentric target rings, labels on the left with leader lines.
- aliases: target, concentric, priorities, rings  |  entry kinds: item, ring  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items

```edd
viz bullseye "Target Market" {
  item "Addressable market" "Everyone who could buy" { icon: globe }
  item "Serviceable market" "Who we can reach today" { icon: target }
  item "Beachhead" "Design-led B2B startups" { icon: flag }
}
```

### viz pyramid

Triangle of stacked levels, numbered, labels staggered on the slope.
- aliases: hierarchy, layers, tiers, triangle  |  entry kinds: item, level  |  sweet spot: 3–6 items

```edd
viz pyramid "Brand Pyramid" {
  item "Essence" "One promise"
  item "Personality" "How we sound and feel"
  item "Benefits" "What customers get"
  item "Attributes" "Features and facts"
}
```

## Mindmap

### viz mindmap

Root with branches fanning left and right; children beyond each branch.
- aliases: mind-map, brainstorm, topics  |  entry kinds: item, root, center  |  sweet spot: 3–8 items

```edd
viz mindmap "Product Launch" {
  item "Marketing" { item "Landing page"; item "Email campaign"; item "Social posts" }
  item "Engineering" { item "Feature freeze"; item "Load testing" }
  item "Sales" { item "Demo script"; item "Pricing sheet" }
  item "Support" { item "Help articles"; item "Escalation plan" }
  item "Legal" { item "Terms update" }
}
```

### viz mindmap-horizontal

Root at the left; branches one column right, children beyond.
- entry kinds: item, root, center  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- layout variant of `mindmap` (same data model; see the mindmap example).

### viz mindmap-left

Mindmap with every branch on the left of the root.
- entry kinds: item, root, center  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- layout variant of `mindmap` (same data model; see the mindmap example).

### viz mindmap-right

Mindmap with every branch on the right of the root.
- entry kinds: item, root, center  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- layout variant of `mindmap` (same data model; see the mindmap example).

### viz mindmap-vertical

Org-chart mindmap: root center, branch cards above/below with elbow trunks.
- entry kinds: item, root, center  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- layout variant of `mindmap` (same data model; see the mindmap example).

## Parts of Whole

### viz iceberg

The visible tip vs the hidden mass below the waterline.
- aliases: visible-hidden, surface-depth, above-below  |  entry kinds: above, below, item  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items

```edd
viz iceberg "Project Effort" {
  above "The demo" "What stakeholders see" { icon: eye }
  below "Testing & hardening" "Edge cases, monitoring, rollback"
  below "Infrastructure" "CI, environments, data migrations"
}
```

## Problems and Solutions

### viz bridge

An arched plank bridge across the gap between two cliffs, the steps as numbered stones (from → to).
- aliases: gap, migration, span, bridge-gap  |  entry kinds: item, step, challenge, plank, from, to  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `action:` (string) — call-to-action caption below the chasm

```edd
viz bridge "Migration Plan" {
  from "Legacy stack" "Monolith on VMs"
  to "New platform" "Services on Kubernetes"
  item "Extract auth"
  item "Move billing"
  item "Split reporting"
  item "Retire monolith"
  action: "One service at a time"
}
```

### viz challenges

Hurdles on a level track across the gap between two cliffs (from → to).
- aliases: hurdles, obstacles, barriers  |  entry kinds: item, step, challenge, plank, from, to  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `action:` (string) — call-to-action caption below the chasm

```edd
viz challenges "Path to Launch" {
  from "Prototype" "Works on my machine"
  to "Production" "Reliable for everyone"
  item "Security review" "Close the audit findings"
  item "Scale testing" "Survive 10x load"
  item "Compliance" "SOC 2 evidence complete"
  action: "Clear every hurdle"
}
```

### viz problem-solution

Problem → central solution circle → outcome, with support captions.
- aliases: issue-fix, challenge-response  |  entry kinds: item, problem, solution, outcome, support  |  sweet spot: 3–6 items

```edd
viz problem-solution "Support Overload" {
  problem "Ticket backlog" "400 open tickets, 3-day replies"
  solution "Self-serve help center"
  outcome "Faster answers" "70% deflection, same-day replies"
  support "Smooth migration for existing users"
  support "Weekly content reviews keep articles fresh"
}
```

### viz transformation

A suspension bridge carrying you from before to after (reference design).
- aliases: before-after, transition, change, makeover  |  entry kinds: item, before, after  |  sweet spot: 2–2 items

```edd
viz transformation "Workflow Cleanup" {
  before "Manual chaos" "Spreadsheets and email threads"
  after "Streamlined flow" "One automated pipeline"
}
```

## Process

### viz cycle

Phases on a ring with sweeping arrows between them.
- aliases: loop, cyclic, circular, feedback-loop  |  entry kinds: item, phase, step  |  sweet spot: 3–8 items

```edd
viz cycle "Build-Measure-Learn" {
  item "Build" "Ship the smallest useful slice" { icon: gear }
  item "Measure" "Watch real usage, not opinions" { icon: chart }
  item "Learn" "Decide: persevere or pivot" { icon: bulb }
}
```

### viz flowchart

Chain of rounded steps with straight arrows; `direction: right` for horizontal.
- aliases: flow, process, workflow, flow-chart, steps-flow  |  entry kinds: item, step  |  sweet spot: 2–7 items
- option `direction:` (right|down) — right (or horizontal) lays the chain horizontally, down (or vertical) stacks it; unset picks horizontal for up to 5 steps with short details
- option `orientation:` (horizontal|vertical) — alias for direction

```edd
viz flowchart "Content Publishing" {
  direction: right
  item "Draft" "Outline, then a first pass" { icon: doc }
  item "Review" "Editor and one peer" { icon: search }
  item "Approve" "Sign-off in the tracker" { icon: check }
  item "Publish" "Ships with the newsletter" { icon: rocket }
}
```

### viz gantt

Cascading task bars over a time grid; `task "Name" start end`.
- aliases: schedule, project-plan, gantt-chart  |  entry kinds: task, item  |  sweet spot: 1–10 items
- option `scale:` (string) — list of tick labels for the time axis
- option `deadline:` (number) — time position of the deadline marker
- option `deadlineLabel:` (string) — caption for the deadline marker

```edd
viz gantt "Release Plan" {
  scale: ["Wk 1", "Wk 2", "Wk 3", "Wk 4", "Wk 5", "Wk 6"]
  deadline: 5
  task "Design" 0 1.5
  task "Build" 1 3.5
  task "QA" 3 4.5
  task "Rollout" 4.5 5
}
```

### viz journey

A winding two-walled ribbon road with numbered stops, one color segment per stage (reference design).
- aliases: roadmap, journey-map, user-journey, path  |  entry kinds: item, stage, stop  |  sweet spot: 3–6 items

```edd
viz journey "User Journey" {
  item "Discover" "Finds us via search or a friend"
  item "Try" "Signs up for the free tier"
  item "Adopt" "Invites the team, builds a habit"
  item "Upgrade" "Converts to a paid plan"
  item "Advocate" "Recommends us to others"
}
```

### viz kanban

Named columns of hand-drawn cards — the task board.
- aliases: board, task-board, kanban-board  |  entry kinds: column, lane, item  |  sweet spot: 2–4 items

```edd
viz kanban "Sprint 12" {
  column "To do" {
    item "Rate limiting"
    item "Billing webhooks"
    item "Dark mode"
  }
  column "Doing" {
    item "Checkout flow" { icon: fire }
    item "SSO login"
  }
  column "Done" {
    item "Search rework" { icon: check }
    item "Onboarding tour" { icon: check }
  }
}
```

### viz sequence

Boustrophedon grid of numbered, titled description panels joined by flow arrows.
- aliases: sequential, step-by-step, procedure  |  entry kinds: item, step  |  sweet spot: 4–9 items
- option `columns:` (number) — grid columns, clamped 2-4 (default 3)

```edd
viz sequence "Customer Onboarding" {
  item "Sign up" "Create an account with email or SSO."
  item "Verify" "Confirm the email address."
  item "Profile" "Add team and workspace details."
  item "Invite" "Bring in the first teammates."
  item "Import" "Load existing project data."
  item "Launch" "Go live with the first project."
}
```

### viz stairs

Ascending abutting step blocks with icon above and label inside each.
- aliases: staircase, steps, step-up, climb  |  entry kinds: item, step  |  sweet spot: 3–6 items

```edd
viz stairs "Growth Ladder" {
  item "Learn" { icon: book }
  item "Build" { icon: gear }
  item "Ship" { icon: rocket }
  item "Scale" { icon: trend-up }
}
```

### viz swimlane-flow

A flowchart over responsibility lanes — who does what, in order.
- aliases: swimlanes, cross-functional-flow, raci-flow  |  entry kinds: lane, step, item  |  sweet spot: 2–4 items

```edd
viz swimlane-flow "Release Process" {
  lane "Product" {
    step "Spec" 0 { icon: doc }
    step "Sign-off" 3 { icon: check }
  }
  lane "Engineering" {
    step "Build" 1 { icon: wrench }
    step "Deploy" 4 { icon: rocket }
  }
  lane "QA" {
    step "Test" 2 { icon: search }
  }
}
```

## Timelines

### viz milestone-path

A winding trail to a summit flag, milestones marked along the way.
- aliases: path-to-goal, summit, trail, journey-to-goal  |  entry kinds: item, milestone, goal  |  sweet spot: 3–6 items
- option `goal:` (string) — summit flag label (or use a `goal` entry)

```edd
viz milestone-path "Road to Launch" {
  item "Prototype" "Q1 — clickable demo"
  item "Private beta" "Q2 — 20 design partners"
  item "Pricing" "Q3 — packaging locked"
  goal "Launch" "Public GA"
}
```

### viz roadmap-lanes

Workstream swimlanes × time columns — the product-roadmap slide.
- aliases: product-roadmap, swimlane-roadmap, quarterly-roadmap, release-plan  |  entry kinds: lane, task, milestone, item  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `scale:` (string[]) — column headers, e.g. ["Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4"]

```edd
viz roadmap-lanes "2027 Roadmap" {
  scale: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]
  lane "Platform" {
    task "SSO + RBAC" 0 1.5
    task "Audit log" 2 3
    icon: gear
  }
  lane "Growth" {
    task "Referrals" 0.5 2
    milestone "Self-serve GA" 3
    icon: trend-up
  }
  lane "Mobile" {
    task "iOS beta" 1 2.5
    task "Android" 2.5 4
    icon: phone
  }
}
```

### viz timeline

A baseline with alternating teardrop pins: icon inside, date + description beside.
- aliases: milestones, chronology, history  |  entry kinds: item, event, milestone  |  sweet spot: 3–7 items

```edd
viz timeline "Company Milestones" {
  item "2019" "Founded in a garage" { icon: home }
  item "2021" "First 1,000 customers" { icon: users }
  item "2023" "Series A raised" { icon: dollar }
  item "2025" "Global expansion" { icon: globe }
}
```

## Visual Metaphors

### viz bottleneck

Flow crowding through a bottle's neck — many in, few out.
- aliases: constraint, chokepoint, throughput  |  entry kinds: item
- option `count:` (number) — upstream circle count, 6-28 (default 16)
- option `in:` (string) — caption over the wide inlet
- option `out:` (string) — caption over the outlet
- option `neck:` (string) — caption naming the constraint, arrowed at the neck

```edd
viz bottleneck "Review Bottleneck" {
  in: "30 PRs/week"
  out: "8 merged"
  neck: "Two reviewers"
}
```

### viz dialogue

A chat transcript between two speakers, bubbles alternating sides.
- aliases: conversation, chat, qa, discussion  |  entry kinds: item, msg, turn, message, speaker  |  sweet spot: 2–6 items
- option `a:` (string) — left speaker name (default A)
- option `b:` (string) — right speaker name (default B)

```edd
viz dialogue "Discovery Call" {
  a: "Customer"
  b: "Sales"
  msg "We spend hours copying data between tools." { speaker: a }
  msg "What would change if that sync was automatic?" { speaker: b }
  msg "We'd save a day a week, easily." { speaker: a }
  msg "Let me show you how the integration works." { speaker: b }
}
```

### viz hole

A pit in the ground with a ladder out — the title carries the message.
- aliases: pit, trap, pitfall, risk  |  entry kinds: 
- option `caption:` (string) — message line below the pit
- option `pit:` (string) — what the pit is, lettered inside it
- option `ladder:` (string) — what the way out is, on a leader from the ladder's head

```edd
viz hole "Technical Debt Trap" {
  pit: "Shortcuts"
  ladder: "Refactor sprints"
  caption: "Every shortcut digs it deeper"
}
```

### viz lens

A focusing lens — several inputs concentrated into one output.
- aliases: focus, magnify, filter  |  entry kinds: item, input, output, out  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `output:` (string) — outcome label when no output entry (else the last item is the output)

```edd
viz lens "Research Focus" {
  item "Interviews" { icon: chat }
  item "Surveys" { icon: doc }
  item "Analytics" { icon: chart }
  output "Insight report" { icon: bulb }
}
```

### viz lighthouse

A lighthouse beam sweeping over labeled rocks — guidance past the risks.
- aliases: guidance, beacon, watch-out  |  entry kinds: item, rock, risk  |  sweet spot: 2–4 items
- option `ship:` (string) — label under the ship sailing past

```edd
viz lighthouse "Compliance Guidance" {
  ship: "Launch plan"
  item "Data residency" "EU hosting required"
  item "Audit gaps" "SOC 2 evidence missing"
  item "Access sprawl" "Stale admin accounts"
}
```

### viz magnet

A horseshoe magnet pulling item chips in — attraction and retention.
- aliases: attraction, retention, pull  |  entry kinds: item  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `label:` (string) — caption under the magnet

```edd
viz magnet "Why Devs Stay" {
  label: "Developer experience"
  item "Fast CI" { icon: rocket }
  item "Clear docs" { icon: book }
  item "Small PRs" { icon: check }
  item "Owned services" { icon: shield }
}
```

### viz performance

Side-by-side donut gauges, one per metric.
- aliases: kpis, metrics, scorecard, dashboard, kpi-donuts  |  entry kinds: item, metric  |  sweet spot: 2–4 items
- option `summary:` (string) — caption under the panels
- option `showValues:` (boolean) — print item values (default true)

```edd
viz performance "Quarterly KPIs" {
  summary: "All three programs are trending above target."
  item "Uptime" 99 "Rolling 90-day availability" { icon: shield }
  item "NPS" 62 "Promoters minus detractors" { icon: heart }
  item "Velocity" 85 "Committed vs delivered" { icon: rocket }
}
```

### viz pillar

Classical columns, one per pillar, icon + label in the shaft, holding up a shared architrave.
- aliases: pillars, columns, foundations, supports  |  entry kinds: item, pillar  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `mission:` (string) — what the pillars hold up, lettered on the architrave

```edd
viz pillar "Company Pillars" {
  mission: "A product people trust"
  item "Trust" "Security and reliability first" { icon: shield }
  item "Craft" "Quality in every detail" { icon: star }
  item "Pace" "Ship and learn weekly" { icon: rocket }
  item "Care" "Customers and each other" { icon: heart }
}
```

### viz prism

One input beam split by a prism into several outputs.
- aliases: refraction, one-to-many, split  |  entry kinds: item, output, out, input, in  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `input:` (string) — input label when no input entry

```edd
viz prism "One Strategy, Many Wins" {
  input "Platform bet" { icon: diamond }
  item "Faster features" { icon: rocket }
  item "Lower costs" { icon: dollar }
  item "New integrations" { icon: puzzle }
  item "Happier devs" { icon: heart }
}
```

### viz race

Karts racing toward the finish line, staggered by rank.
- aliases: competition, finish-line, contest  |  entry kinds: item, racer, kart  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items
- option `finish:` (string) — banner text over the finish gate (default FINISH)

```edd
viz race "Market Race" {
  item "Us" "38% share, up 6 pts" 78
  item "Competitor X" "31% share, flat" 61
}
```

### viz trend

A rising staircase of progress with labeled levels on leader lines.
- aliases: growth, upward, trajectory, maturity, rising  |  entry kinds: item, step, level  |  sweet spot: 2–5 items

```edd
viz trend "Maturity Curve" {
  item "Ad hoc" "Heroics and hotfixes" { icon: fire }
  item "Repeatable" "Checklists and runbooks" { icon: doc }
  item "Automated" "CI/CD end to end" { icon: gear }
  item "Self-healing" "Systems fix themselves" { icon: star }
}
```

### viz tug-of-war

Two teams pulling a rope — the marker drifts toward the stronger side.
- aliases: force-field, push-pull, tension  |  entry kinds: side, team  |  sweet spot: 2–2 items
- option `tilt:` (left|right|balanced) — override the computed balance

```edd
viz tug-of-war "Ship now vs. polish" {
  side "Ship now" 3 {
    item "Market window closing"
    item "Competitor launched"
    item "Team is burning out"
  }
  side "Keep polishing" 1 {
    item "Two rough edges left"
  }
}
```

### viz vision

A staircase rising from today toward an open door (the vision).
- aliases: goal, aspiration, destination, north-star  |  entry kinds: item, current, vision  |  sweet spot: 2–2 items

```edd
viz vision "Where We're Headed" {
  current "Today" "Regional player, 2 products"
  vision "Global platform" "The door is open by 2028"
}
```

# ▸ Runnable examples (examples/*.edd)

Each is a complete EDodoDraw program. Paste any into the playground
(https://vivmagarwal.github.io/edododraw/#/playground) or compile it with `compileEdd(source)`.

## examples/animated-arrows.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Animated Arrow Gallery" }

// EDodoDraw ships far more animated connectors than Excalidraw.
scene {
  layout dag { direction: right, gap: 120 }

  circle a "A" { fill: blue }
  circle b "B" { fill: green }

  a -> b "flow"          { animate: flow }
  a -> b "dash-march"    { animate: dash-march }
  a -> b "draw-on"       { animate: draw-on }
  a -> b "comet"         { animate: comet, color: red }
  a -> b "gradient-flow" { animate: gradient-flow }
  a -> b "electric"      { animate: electric, color: violet }
  a -> b "pulse"         { animate: pulse }
}
```

## examples/architecture.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "WebShop Reference Architecture" }

theme light {
  tokens { $accent: #2563eb, $muted: #9ca3af, $danger: #e03131 }
}

style .card     { shape: round-rect, fill: blue }
style .critical { stroke: $danger, strokeWidth: bold }

defaults {
  edge { endArrow: arrow }
}

scene {
  use theme light
  layout dag { direction: down, gap: 64, rankGap: 110 }

  actor  client "User"
  cloud  cdn    "CDN / Edge"       { fill: cyan }
  hexagon gw    "API Gateway"      { fill: violet, strokeWidth: bold }

  group services "Application Services" {
    round-rect auth   "Auth Service"  :::card
    round-rect api    "API Service"   :::card :::critical
    subroutine worker "Async Worker"
  }

  group data "Data Layer" {
    cylinder      db    "Postgres"       { fill: teal }
    cylinder      cache "Redis"          { fill: red }
    parallelogram queue "Message Queue"  { fill: orange }
  }

  note legacy "Legacy Billing\n(deprecate)" { at: (760, 40), pin: true, strokeStyle: dashed }

  // Arrowhead + animation variety
  client  -> cdn    "https"
  cdn     ==> gw    "cache miss"   { color: $accent }
  gw      -> auth   "authZ"        { startArrow: dot }
  gw      -> api    "REST"         { animate: dash-march }
  api     ~> worker "enqueue"      { animate: flow }
  api     -> db     "write"        { endArrow: triangle, animate: draw-on }
  api     -.-> cache "read-through"
  worker  -> queue  "publish"      { animate: comet, color: $accent }
  queue   -> db     "persist"
  api     -x legacy "deprecated"   { color: $muted, strokeStyle: dashed }
}

annotate "persistent" {
  callout db "source of truth" { placement: bottom }
}

timeline story {
  beat overview "The whole system" {
    camera fit-all over 800ms
    reveal { show all with fade-in }
    narrate: "End-to-end request path."
  }

  beat ingress "Traffic enters at the edge" {
    camera focus [client, cdn, gw] zoom 1.5 ease spring
    reveal { show [client, cdn, gw] with pop }   // pop the entry path into focus
    annotate {
      point-at gw "single entry point" { from: ne, color: $accent }
      highlight cdn { color: yellow }
    }
  }

  beat services "Inside the app tier" {
    camera focus services zoom 1.6
    reveal { show [auth, api, worker] with pop }
    annotate {
      spotlight services { dim: 0.72 }
      underline api "the hot path" { color: $accent }
    }
    narrate: "Auth fronts the API; the worker drains async jobs."
  }

  beat data "Where state lives" {
    camera focus data zoom 1.7 ease ease-in-out
    reveal { draw-on [db, cache, queue] }        // sweep the data stores in
    annotate {
      callout db "primary of record" { placement: right }
      circle-mark queue "retry here"
    }
    narrate: "All writes funnel through Postgres; Redis is read-through."
    hold: 2s
  }
}
```

## examples/characters-beside-diagram.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Scaffold vs. Wheelchair", style: classic-color }

// Standalone `character` and `icon` nodes put PEOPLE and OBJECTS next to the
// diagram as ordinary nodes: real bboxes, so they lay out, connect, focus,
// reveal, annotate and draw on like any shape. `flip` turns a figure so the
// two columns face each other.

scene {
  layout dag { direction: down, gap: 120, rankGap: 80 }

  text title "Two kinds of support" { at: (150, -155), fontSize: 40, pin: true }
  text ask   "Is the goal to take it away?" { at: (150, -98), fontSize: 22, pin: true }

  group temporary "Temporary — you take it away" {
    character climber "The learner" {
      pose: climbing, emotion: determined, hair: messy, shirt: tee, fx: sweat
      height: 230
    }
    icon scaffold "Scaffolding" { size: 100 }
    round-rect alone "Climbs it alone" { fill: green }
  }

  group permanent "Permanent — it stays" {
    character rider "The learner" {
      pose: sitting, emotion: content, hair: bob, shirt: hoodie, accessory: glasses
      height: 230, flip: true
    }
    icon wheelchair "Wheelchair" { size: 100 }
    round-rect access "Reaches the same door" { fill: blue }
  }

  edge leans: climber    --> scaffold   "leans on"
  edge down:  scaffold   --> alone      "then comes down"

  // named edges so the timeline can hide the whole right column at first
  edge rolls: rider      --> wheelchair "moves with"
  edge daily: wheelchair --> access     "every day"
  edge back:  access     ~> rider       "and back again"
}

annotate "persistent" {
  strike scaffold                          // the whole point: it comes down
}

timeline story {
  beat left "Scaffolding comes down" {
    camera focus temporary zoom 1.1 ease ease-in-out
    reveal {
      hide [rider, wheelchair, access, rolls, daily, back]   // sticky: hide once…
      draw-on [climber, scaffold, alone]
    }
    narrate: "Scaffolding is support you build in order to take it away."
    hold: 2s
  }
  beat right "Access stays" {
    camera focus permanent zoom 1.1 ease ease-in-out
    reveal { show [rider, wheelchair, access, rolls, daily, back] with draw-on }  // …show here
    annotate { circle-mark wheelchair "never remove this one" }
    narrate: "Access is support you never remove — and shouldn't."
    hold: 2s
  }
  beat both "Tell them apart" {
    camera fit-all over 900ms
    reveal { show all with fade-in }
    narrate: "One question tells them apart: is the goal to take it away?"
  }
}
```

## examples/flowchart.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Signup Flow" }

scene {
  layout dag { direction: down, gap: 60 }

  start([Start])
  form[Signup Form]
  valid{Valid?}
  ok(Create Account):::good
  err(Show Errors):::bad

  start --> form
  form  --> valid
  valid -->|yes| ok
  valid -->|no|  err
  err   --> form
}

style .good { stroke: green, fill: green }
style .bad  { stroke: red,   fill: red }
```

## examples/mermaid-import.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Imported from Mermaid" }

// Paste raw Mermaid — EDodoDraw imports it, keeps the node ids,
// and lets you choreograph a walkthrough on top.
mermaid """
flowchart LR
  app[App Servers] --> otel[OTel Collector]
  otel --> prom[Prometheus]
  otel --> loki[Loki]
  prom --> grafana[Grafana]
  loki --> grafana
  prom --> alertmgr[Alertmanager]
"""

timeline walkthrough {
  beat all "Pipeline overview" {
    camera fit-all over 700ms
    narrate: "Telemetry flows left to right into Grafana."
  }
  beat collect "Collection" {
    camera focus [app, otel] zoom 1.7
    annotate {
      highlight otel { color: yellow }
      point-at otel "single ingestion point" { from: s }
    }
  }
  beat visualize "Dashboards & alerts" {
    camera focus [grafana, alertmgr] zoom 1.6
    annotate {
      circle-mark grafana "the pane of glass"
      callout alertmgr "pages on-call" { placement: top }
    }
  }
}
```

## examples/visualizations.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Visualizations" }

// 62 chart & diagram templates ship built-in — declare DATA, get a diagram.
// The default look is the black-and-white hand-drawn Classic. Add a style to
// restyle everything, e.g. `meta { style: classic-color }` — also colorful-lines,
// chalkboard, crayon, earthy-gradient, mono-accent, fine-line, neutral-lines.
// Full catalog: Docs → Visualizations.

viz funnel sales "Sales Funnel" {
  input: "Potential customers"
  output: "Closed deals"
  item "Awareness" 5000
  item "Interest" 1800 "Warm leads in the CRM"
  item "Evaluation" 420
  item "Won" 38 { icon: trophy }
}

viz venn "Product Sweet Spot" {
  set "Desirable" "What users want" { icon: heart }
  set "Feasible" "What we can build" { icon: gear }
  set "Viable" "What sustains us" { icon: dollar }
  overlap all "Great products"
}

viz cycle "Build-Measure-Learn" {
  item "Build" "Ship the smallest useful slice" { icon: gear }
  item "Measure" "Watch real usage, not opinions" { icon: chart }
  item "Learn" "Decide: persevere or pivot" { icon: bulb }
}

// Viz elements are ordinary scene elements: annotate them, focus them, edit them.
annotate {
  circle-mark sales.won "the goal"
}

timeline {
  beat all "Everything" { camera fit-all }
  beat funnel "The funnel" { camera focus sales.won zoom 1.6 }
}
```

## examples/welcome.edd

```edd
edd 1.0
meta { title: "Welcome to EDodoDraw" }

// Everything you see is generated from THIS code.
// Edit anything on the left and the diagram updates live.

scene {
  layout dag { direction: down, gap: 72 }

  ellipse     hello "Hello 👋"                 { fill: yellow }
  rect        idea  "Diagrams as CODE"         { fill: blue }
  round-rect  vibe  "…with the Excalidraw vibe" { fill: green }
  diamond     edit  "Try editing me!"          { fill: violet }

  hello --> idea   "type"
  idea  --> vibe   "render"
  vibe  --> edit   "enjoy"
  edit  ~> hello   "loop"        // ~>  == a flowing animated arrow
}
```
